fields.description: 16-entry 4-byte record table (per-record: u16le value, flag byte 0x01/0x02, 0xFF pad). Persisted as EEPROM blocks 40-47 by the FUN_08011920 read / FUN_08011960 write whole-image loops via FUN_08011c4c / FUN_08011cfc 8-byte block transfers; per-record meaning inferred from the regular stride in baseline, not from a named game accessor.
fields.evidence: FUN_08011920 loops FUN_08011c4c over all EEPROM blocks into the RAM save mirror _DAT_08000f3c; FUN_08011960 writes the mirror back with FUN_08011cfc; FUN_08011c4c/FUN_08011cfc move 4 words (8 bytes) per EEPROM address. Baseline logical 0x144..0x183 holds 16x [u16le, 01/02, FF].
fields.name: track_record_table
